crossRefs.note: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…
But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise,
Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
“Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…
Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”
“Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”
This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of…
